definitions.era: pre-2021 (date < 2021-01-01) | mev-geth-2021-22 (to the Merge, block 15537394) | early-pbs-2022-23 (Merge to 2023-12-31) | mature-pbs-2024-26 (2024-01-01 on); same eras as evolution study E1-E4
definitions.headline: verdict == confirmed-onchain AND race_type in {beat-pending-attack, deploy-window-copy}, excluding Euler (operator identity unresolved)
definitions.fate.return_status: returned = everything went back to the victim side except a bounty the victim agreed to or offered; partial = some came back, otherwise; none = known zero within the documented search window; unknown = unresolved
definitions.race_type: beat-pending-attack | deploy-window-copy | beat-whitehat-or-user | post-failure-replay | bot-was-first-exploiter | late-copy | no-race (added: rejected sub-races where nobody raced)
definitions.blocks_ahead: attacker_block - bot.block (positive = bot landed that many blocks BEFORE the attacker's racing tx; 0 = same block, see ordering; negative = bot landed after). null when the attacker's call never landed (deploy-window copies; see attacker_reference) or there is no attacker
definitions.slot_start: 1606824023 + 12 * slot (unix s); auction.escalation = record-bid curve [[ms relative to slot start, ETH]], max 60 points (largest jumps kept)
definitions.detection_delay_ms: trigger first seen in the public mempool (mempool-dumpster, earliest source) -> first bid by the WINNING builder's pubkey after the trigger worth >= max(2x its own best earlier bid, 0.5 ETH); relays never reveal losing-bid contents so this is a proxy; detection_delay_ub_ms = trigger -> first submission of the winning block hash (contents verified)
definitions.loot.gross_loot_eth: ETH-equivalent the bot tx extracted before paying the builder
definitions.loot.pct_to_builder: (bot tx coinbase transfers + priority fee) / gross_loot_eth * 100; the builder may pass most on (see auction.proposer_paid_eth, builder_refund, builder_payout_to_victim)
definitions.loot.pct_to_proposer: winning bid / gross_loot_eth * 100 (bot-tx scope, bot tx in the winning block, bid history available)
definitions.fate.returned_pct: returned_total_eth / gross_loot_eth * 100, where returned_total_eth reached the victim/protocol side out of the row's proceeds (bot returns + builder pass-through; net of any bounty the bot kept)
definitions.fate.returned_pct_of_gross: returned_total_eth / loot.gross_loot_eth * 100 (gross = ETH-equivalent the bot tx took from the victim, before the coinbase payment). fate.returned_pct is kept and is IDENTICAL to this field for every row
definitions.fate.returned_pct_of_bot_net: fate.returned_by_bot_side_eth / loot.bot_net_eth * 100 (bot_net = gross - coinbase - gas + builder refund; builder/proposer pass-through excluded from the numerator). null where bot_net is under 0.05 ETH or excludes the main proceeds (see fate.returned_pct_note)
definitions.fate.returned_by_builder_or_proposer_eth: ETH a builder / proposer-side recipient passed on to the victim (Blueberry builder -> multisig 366.63; Makina builder -> 0xbed2 -> Safe 920.7); null = none seen
definitions.fate.returned_by_bot_side_eth: returned_total_eth - returned_by_builder_or_proposer_eth: returned by the row's own actors (for Sushi RP2 also the whitehats), net of bounty
definitions.fate.victim_loss_eth / returned_pct_of_v: victim's ETH-equivalent loss to the bot tx (equals gross_loot_eth except Earning.Farm = gross - 0.1 ETH deposit; null for Balancer, UNCX) and returned_total_eth / that * 100
definitions.evidence_level_mempool: measured | in-block-only (before 2023-08-07, no archive) | absent-from-archive (archive covers the day, the attacker/bot txs are not in it)
